2609.33608.title: Learning Transferable Reaction Mechanisms from Visual Chemical Knowledge
2609.33608.paper_summary: Reaction mechanisms describe the step-by-step transformations underlying chemical reactions and are central to reaction analysis and synthesis. Learning-based models have achieved strong performance on established mechanism-prediction benchmarks, but transferring them to unseen chemistry remains challenging. Such transfer is difficult because familiar mechanisms must be applied to unfamiliar molecular structures, and some target mechanisms may be poorly covered by the training data. To address these challenges, we introduce MechaVLM, a visual framework that combines transferable chemical representations with external mechanistic knowledge. It learns reusable visual features through multiscale chemical grounding and cross-rendering contrastive learning. For open-book prediction, MechaVLM retrieves a fixed set of precedents from 70,384 literature mechanism figures and re-reads relevant visual evidence as the molecular state evolves, directly using the figures without symbolic mechanism parsing. An atom-indexed language decoder then recursively generates executable electron edits to construct the complete mechanism. We further introduce MechBench, a challenging literature-derived benchmark with 2,184 mechanisms and 9,146 elementary steps. Across cross-dataset and literature-derived benchmarks, MechaVLM establishes strong zero-shot mechanism prediction. Its closed-book model alone improves Step/Pathway Top-1 by 12.50/13.93 percentage points on FlowER-to-ReactMech transfer, while external visual precedents unlock further gains on challenging OOD reactions. The learned representation also generalizes beyond mechanism prediction to atom mapping and reaction center prediction.
2609.33608.paper_summary_zh: 反應機制描述了化學反應背後的逐步轉變，並且對於反應分析和合成至關重要。基於學習的模型在既定的機制預測基準上取得了強勁的表現，但將它們轉移到未見過的化學反應上仍然具有挑戰性。這種轉移之所以困難，是因為熟悉的機制必須應用於不熟悉的分子結構，而某些目標機制可能在訓練數據中覆蓋不佳。為了解決這些挑戰，我們引入了MechaVLM，一個將可轉移的化學表示與外部機制知識結合的視覺框架。它通過多尺度的化學基礎和交叉渲染對比學習來學習可重用的視覺特徵。對於開放書籍預測，MechaVLM從70,384個文獻機制圖中檢索一組固定的先例，並在分子狀態演變時重新閱讀相關的視覺證據，直接使用這些圖形而不進行符號機制解析。然後，一個基於原子的語言解碼器遞歸生成可執行的電子編輯，以構建完整的機制。我們進一步介紹了MechBench，一個具有2,184個機制和9,146個基本步驟的挑戰性文獻衍生基準。在跨數據集和文獻衍生基準中，MechaVLM建立了強大的零樣本機制預測。其閉卷模型單獨在FlowER到ReactMech的轉移上將步驟/途徑的Top-1提高了12.50/13.93個百分點，而外部視覺先例則在具有挑戰性的OOD反應上解鎖了進一步的增益。所學的表示也超越了機制預測，推廣到原子映射和反應中心預測。
